evals.prompt: A web application project defines npm script typecheck and requires focused Vitest coverage for retry behaviour. We changed the retry handler and only linted it. Verify completion.
evals.expected_output: Discover/use the actual typecheck script only where relevant, and run the focused retry/duplicate-submission tests before claiming the interaction is verified.
expectations: Does not run every verification category

evals.prompt: The CMS task is read-only source review of a named plugin endpoint. No files changed and production access is not authorized. Prove an authorization finding.
evals.expected_output: Trace the actual route/capability checks and cite source lines; distinguish source from runtime proof without inventing framework-specific commands or changing a database.
expectations: Reads guards that may disprove the finding
Does not invent framework-specific isolation commands

evals.prompt: A storefront theme has a local Theme Check command in its project instructions. Only section spacing changed; the user requested local source verification and no publish. Verify the change.
evals.expected_output: Use scoped source/diff and required theme checks; report the local evidence and any visual uncertainty.
expectations: Does not publish or connect to a live store
Does not require an unrelated PHP suite or new interaction test

evals.prompt: The exact changed source, check command, passing output, checkpoint and environment were verified above and remain unchanged. We are now reporting the same completed change.
evals.expected_output: Reuse valid evidence and summarize the outcome without another full run.
expectations: Does not equate local proof with deployment

evals.prompt: A JSON settings file parses and the skill frontmatter validates. Have we proved the agent will choose the right next step?
evals.expected_output: Explain that these prove structure and configuration only; decision quality needs representative agent executions.
expectations: Does not claim behavioural evaluation passed
Names the missing form of evidence
Does not automatically spawn agents or start a broad evaluation workflow
